# Pacifica Beauty Devocean Lipstick in Rebel Sol

Bold, hydrating color made with a 100% vegan formula.

## Rich Color With Creamy Comfort

Devocean is a full-color natural lipstick with a creamy texture and highly pigmented finish. Rebel Sol builds vivid color for everyday wear or a standout look for evenings out.

## Hydration for Softer-Looking Lips

This lipstick is formulated to nourish, helping lips feel moisturized as you wear it. Its smooth application makes it a comfortable choice for dry lips that need extra care.

## Ingredients That Match Your Values

Every Devocean lipstick is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. It's formulated without carmine, phthalates, petroleum, or silicone, so you can choose color that aligns with your standards for what goes on your lips.

## Find Your Shade

Choose from six shades: Beach Goth, Natural Mystic, Firebird, Rebel Sol, Tenderness, and XOX. Build a collection that suits every mood, from understated days to bold nights.

## Make Rebel Sol Yours

Add Rebel Sol to your routine for vegan, hydrating color that keeps your lips looking soft and kissable. Shop now and find your new everyday favorite.
